_doc: FINALS WEEK 1 — the first finals application. A FINALS WEEK IS NOT A ROUND ADVANCE: feed round 25 is a ledger key, the CALENDAR round is HELD at 24, calendar_progress stays 1.00, and every non-finalist's completed season is untouched. Because the board moves and the round does not, this act EARNS an out-of-round column and a lineage entry, exactly as a dial flip does (standing owner rule 2026-07-28).
act: FW1 — FINALS WEEK 1 APPLIED (feed round 25; the calendar round HELD at 24)
owner_word: Explicit word given (owner, verbatim, 2026-08-30), on the FW1 direct-movers preview: 87 movers, all of them players who played, pool 702,917 -> 704,376. Sheet: "Yes, Viney has returned. Nobody else."
authority: owner screenshots of the FootyWire SC column 2026-08-30 (transcribed, verified against his own conservation check); fixture 'FW1 is 4 teams playing' + the four clubs; DNP ruling 'should carry a DNP but the DNP shouldn't directly count against a player'

prereg._doc_board_after: null for a real application: the board is a function of scores nobody has priced yet, and a seat predicting it would be copying it out of a build already run.
prereg._doc_round_expected: absent_dnp is 93 — the players at the FOUR clubs that PLAYED who were not selected. It is NOT 712: the 619 at clubs that did not play are UNRECORDED, not DNP, which is the owner's ruling of 2026-08-30 and is asserted as a partition inside round_movers (played + dnp + unrecorded == the priced board).

sheet.owner_word: Yes, Viney has returned. Nobody else.
sheet.disclosed_movers: jack-viney — injured Y -> N. He played Finals Week 1 for Melbourne (SC 55) while the pinned sheet carried him injured=Y with games_2026=0. EXACTLY ONE ROW DIFFERS across the file and only the `injured` column moved on it, asserted column-by-column after the write.

round._doc_number: THE FEED ROUND, which is a (player, season, round) dedup-ledger key and NOT the calendar. staged_apply holds as_of_round at calendar_rounds = 24.
round._doc_clubs_played: Owner, 2026-08-30: 'FW1 is 4 teams playing'. Declared, never inferred: a club can field a player the store has at another club, and three did in FW1 before their corrections landed.
round._doc_identity_overrides: Will Hayes resolves to two rows — will-hayes-b (Collingwood, active, 9 games in 2026) and will-hayes-1 (no club, retired, no scoring). Owner: 'Will Hayes is Will Hayes b'.
round._doc_arming: LAW 10(c): arming the score-write needs the owner's explicit word. His word is recorded VERBATIM above. THE TOKEN FOLLOWS THE R24 CONVENTION (R24-2026-08-23-owner-approved) because he gave his word without naming one; it is a non-empty marker, not a stored secret — `_apply_enabled()` requires only that it be set, alongside the separate ARMED code half. The protection that matters is his authorisation, which is his; the string is a label on the record, and it is flagged here rather than passed off as his.

identities._doc_unmoved: as_of_round is UNMOVED and that is the whole design. A finals week adds games and scores to the store while the calendar holds at 24, so calendar_progress stays 1.00 and a non-finalist's season stays complete.
